per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 rechecked all 51 linked rows. caution_findings.evidence_context: Source XML Table 2 has Penicillium notatum and the recovered supplementary DOCX Fig. S7 has Penicillium notatum AS3.4356; DBAASP/CAMP rows use Penicillium chrysogenum AS3.4356. Values are preserved, but the species-name conflict is not normalized.
Source material supports antimicrobial MIC phenotype and COM-domain biosynthetic mechanism only.
The paper is source-reviewed and gate-clean, but not clean-accepted because database target nomenclature conflicts remain preserved.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 source re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001.
